record.paper: Triangle-free planar graphs with at most $64^{n^{0.731}}$ 3-colorings

dossier_meta.paper: Triangle-free planar graphs with at most $64^{n^{0.731}}$ 3-colorings
dossier_meta.statement_text: There exists a constant $c > 1$ such that every $n$-vertex triangle-free planar graph has at least $c^{n^{\log_{9/2} 3}}$ distinct proper 3-colorings.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 1 of the paper provides, for infinitely many $n$, an $n$-vertex triangle-free planar graph with at most $64^{n^{\log_{9/2} 3}} < 64^{n^{0.731}}$ 3-colorings, improving Thomassen's construction. The authors conjecture that the exponent $\log_{9/2} 3 \approx 0.731$ in the upper bound is optimal, making Conjecture 1 the matching lower-bound statement.
